behaviors.behavior: A binding naming only unit tests is rejected (HARD) once integration/e2e executed-passing evidence exists for the same FR
A binding already naming the highest executed-passing layer is clean
A gap on a legacy/defaulted required_layers_source routes ADVISORY, not HARD (pre-rollout valve)
A gap on a collision display id routes ADVISORY regardless of source
No gap without a real behaviour change (row+AC delta), even if the binding/evidence gap exists
No gap when no layer has executed-passing evidence (nothing to judge yet)
Severity routing is the ONE shared function evaluate_cross_layer also uses, not a second mirrored copy
Multiple required_layers credits the highest named layer even when evidence sits between them
A binding declaring a layer HIGHER than any evidence proves is clean (division of labor with evaluate_cross_layer)
behaviors.evidence: `test_binding_declared_higher_than_any_evidence_is_clean` PASSED — external plan-review finding, openai; re-affirmed at code-review (rejected-with-reason, see ADR)
